title: Red-cell size–dispersion interaction did not establish added cross-cycle cognitive-score prediction beyond flexible marginal measures
abstract: A standardized RDW-by-MCV interaction did not establish incremental DSST prediction from NHANES 2011–12 to independently sampled 2013–14: weighted MSE reduction 0.2897 score-squared units; two-sample preprocessing-and-coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-2.5977, 2.1715].
